notes.title: 🌿 Help Us Shape the Next Major Update! 🌿
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we’re preparing for a major update to Lakeside Bar, we’d love to hear your thoughts on which new features you’d be most excited about.

[b]Here are a couple of ideas we’re considering:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Farming on the lakeside[/b] to grow ingredients for your bar (and yes, fishing can also provide ingredients 🎣).
[*] [b]Keeping cute pets[/b] by the lakeside to make your bar feel even cozier. 🐾
[/list][b]We’d love to know[/b]: which feature excites you more? Or do you have other ideas that you think would make Lakeside Bar even better?

You can share your feedback wherever it’s most convenient for you - right here in the Steam discussion, via our Google Form, or through any of Lakeside Bar’s social channels. 

Survey form: https://forms.gle/Qekv7x2uoQbQWDST8

We’ll gather everything and take it into account as we plan the update

Thank you and hope you have a nice day ^^
Lakeside Bar Team

notes.title: Patch Note Update v0.4.3
notes.content:
[b]Gashapon (Memory Capsule)[/b]
•⁠  ⁠Added +1000 gold cost after each roll to balance the high value of gashapon items.
•⁠  ⁠Major adjustments to item stats.
•⁠  ⁠Introduced 6 new player stats for bar optimization: Mixing Speed, Cooking Speed, Fishing Speed, Clean Mike Speed, Clean Bar Counter Speed, Clean Table Speed.

[b]Balance & Adjustments[/b]
•⁠  ⁠When the bar counter or Chef Mike gets dirty, Mixing Speed or - Cooking Speed will be reduced by 50% until cleaned.
•⁠  ⁠Employees: each task now consumes different working amounts (live values visible in the menu).

[b]UI/UX[/b]
•⁠  ⁠New “destock” function for drinks/dishes in the menu via right-click (or hold to quick destock), available only when the item is not equipped in Today’s Menu.
•⁠  ⁠Employee working amounts are now displayed directly on each employee card.
•⁠  ⁠Gashapon moved above the menu so players can view the bar and shelf while rolling.
•⁠  ⁠Today’s Menu now shows the fame level required to unlock each slot.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
•⁠  ⁠Fixed gold reward issue for players coming from the demo version.
•⁠  ⁠Fixed media player auto-pausing issue.
•⁠  ⁠Fixed furniture/decoration placement issues that prevented buying, moving, or placing.

[b]Not on the menu… yet[/b]
But, someone’s been spotted near the bar entrance. Could they be your next recruit? 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/04e87bd368bdcc5b76b8d0da5e0066f8eca0f844.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support. Enjoy the new changes and keep building the bar of your dreams ️🎉

notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!

We’re always listening, so feel free to drop your thoughts or bug reports anytime![/p]

tags.feature: In "Lakeside Bar" players become the owner of a tavern. To the accompaniment of melodious jazz music, players complete a series of simple tasks, such as recruiting staff, creating menus, and freely renovating their establishment. Then, they can lead their staff to meet the constant demand for drinks and snacks from their guests.
After accumulating initial capital, tavern owners can leave on-site duties to the bartenders and waitstaff, enjoying the life of a retired angler in their backyard.

When bar owners are working in real life, they only need to start the game and choose to open the bar, and the bar will run automatically 24 hours a day. The staff will complete all the needs of the guests in an orderly manner, earning you a steady stream of gold coins.

Bar owners only need to return to the game in their spare time to restock, renovate, and expand. You can gradually watch your bar go from poverty to a sci-fi cyberpunk style. Build your own dream tavern, free your hands, and it's easy and painless.
There are a vast collection of illustrated books waiting for you, Bar Owners, to satisfy your collecting itch!
We can study our patrons' preferences and increase their favorability with customized menus, unlocking many potential exclusive recipes, such as the Molotov and Beef Bowl.
Then, by having the bunny girl bartender and microwave chef continue research and development, our tavern can create highly profitable special dishes, rapidly expanding its business.
In addition to fishing, Bar Owners can also enjoy various tavern mini-games we're continuously developing, such as Dart and Mete.
We can obtain special tokens by selling catches and playing mini-games, which can be used to purchase special outfits to further decorate the bar and make it the most comfortable place by the lake.

Finally, there is an irresistible gashapon machine in the game. For only 1,000 gold coins, you can randomly draw props with special bonuses and display them on the shelves of the bar, which is both beautiful and practical.

notes.title: Devlog#05: Upcoming Features
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We’ve got a couple of cozy new additions to share in this latest dev update. Whether you're a fan of slow, peaceful fishing or want to bring your own music into the bar - this one’s for you.

[b]🎣 New: Focus Fishing Mode[/b]
You can now activate Focus Fishing when entering a fishing spot!
In this mode:
[list]
[*] Your character will stay in place and can’t move until you manually cancel.
[*] The fishing timer remains the same: 30 seconds = 1 fish.
[*] A new mini-game mechanic has been added: a hook moves up and down inside a gauge.
[*] Tap the icon or press the keybind to interact.
[/list]Hitting different areas on the gauge gives you progress boosts:
[list]
[*] Normal hit: -5 sec
[*] Perfect hit: -10 sec
[*] Miss: Nothing happens (it won’t increase or decrease the progress time)
[/list] There are no new fish types in this version - just a new way to enjoy the current system!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/c06e6a125d4f8ec129a602f4913cffbad838467b.png[/img]

[b]🎵 New: Record Player & Custom Music[/b]
[i]You can now import your own music into the game! 🎧[/i]
We’ve added a record player feature that works just like a simple music app, allowing you to edit your playlist and set the vibe however you like. Whether it’s chill lofi, jazzy beats, or your favorite playlist, it’s your bar, your vibe.

Important notice: excessive importing tracks may impact the game performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/754818e5f9b8dba944cbd11db34b14d4eb05e912.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/3b7d1c3d3b4d9360c041a19e3ded72527cc5641b.png[/img]

That’s all for now! Thanks again for playing and for all your feedback. It helps us so much as we continue shaping Lakeside Bar into something special. 💛

Let us know what kind of music you’ll be playing at your bar!

notes.title: 📢 [Golden Rod Event Notice] About Screenshot Visibility – Solution
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’ve noticed that some players are having trouble seeing their Golden Rod event screenshots appear in the Community Hub. This happens because screenshots taken during the demo are automatically tagged as “demo” by Steam, which prevents them from showing up publicly in the game’s main hub.

[b]🛠️ How to submit your entry instead:[/b]
If your screenshot doesn't appear in the Community Hub:
[list]
[*] Upload it to your Steam profile (please set it to Public).
[*] Share the link in the Golden Rod Event thread under the Discussions tab.
[/list]After the event ends, we’ll gather all valid entries from the discussion thread and randomly select 10 lucky participants

🙏 We sincerely apologize for this unexpected inconvenience. Thank you for your understanding and for joining our fishing fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/ff5414def0874f493770bc725ab06ca161bfc802.png[/img]

notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re back with another update for Lakeside Bar - and this one brings some exciting new features we can’t wait to share with you!

[b][h2]🎯 Token Shop[/h2][/b]
Introducing a brand-new Token Shop!
You can now earn special tokens through two different activities:
- Fishing
- Bar games & minigames

Each activity gives you its own type of currency, and you can use these tokens to unlock unique decorations for your bar! 

Bonus tips:
- Selling fish, playing bar games, and completing minigames can all earn you more tokens.
- Got too much Gold? You can also exchange some of it into tokens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/2ee4a2bfa979aeeb74b431f9633f11cf365f242d.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Customer Profiles
[/h2][/b]
Now you can get to know your customers a little better!
Check their profiles to learn about:
- Whether they’re newcomers or beloved regulars
- Their favorite drinks
- Their drinking tolerance
- How generous they are with tips ...and other fun details!

It’s a small touch, but we hope it makes your bar feel even more alive. 💙
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/c41caf01a63eff86603a77e4725e81dc904cf6ae.png[/img]

[b][h2]Staff Training[/h2][/b]
We thought a lot about how staff members naturally grow through time and experience, so here’s what we’ve added:
- You can now train your staff to boost their work efficiency!
- Set task priorities depending on what your bar needs most.
- And the more they work, the more their expertise will naturally improve — just like in real life.

Help your team grow with you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/b324bfec7fda4c2c92bd9f2bb66c61e8c7468906.png[/img]

[h2][b]Today’s Menu[/b][/h2]
Want more control over your bar’s vibe each day?
Now you can set a daily menu with selected drinks and food!
Guests will visit depending on whether their favorite items are available — a simple way to create your own daily special atmosphere.

We’re still hard at work, and every piece of feedback from you means the world to us.
Thank you so much for supporting this little cozy world we're building. 🍃

Stay tuned — we have even more surprises on the way!
💬 Feel free to leave your thoughts, wishlist the game, or just drop by to say hi.

See you at the bar!

notes.title: [Devlog] New Features in Progress
notes.content:
Hi there,

We're excited to share some of the latest updates we're working on for the game! Here are some new features and improvements coming your way. Check them out below!

[b][h2]Minigames[/h2][/b]
[b]We’re currently working on several mini-games[/b], and one of them is [b]dart game[/b]. Your goal is to land perfect shots and bring your score down to exactly 0 before your opponent does. Can you become the dart master?

👉 [b]Sneak Peek: Here’s a first look at the dart minigame![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/406bda2184182beccd0a447a0537bcc7aff5cb2c.png[/img]

More fun is on the way, so [b]stay tuned![/b]

[h2][b]New Decorations[/b][/h2]
You can decorate the bar area and the small garden above to suit your style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/1493d64b1918dd083287e9d8303c2044ea201f0a.png[/img]

We’re currently working on new decoration items for the bar area!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434743/dc4a8af7173e115b502324d7fb4e64921b4612e7.png[/img]

Below is a preview of some new decoration items. [b]These are still in the review stage, so if you have any ideas, feel free to share them with us![/b]

[h2][b]Improvement[/b][/h2]
We’re continuously testing and optimizing the game to make sure it’s the best experience possible. If you have any feedback or ideas, feel free to share them on the [b]Steam Community or Discord![/b]

Thanks for your support! 🙏

We hope you enjoy these updates and stay tuned for more!
